HAPPENING NOW: The advance screening of ‘Passenger’ on Wednesday, May 20, at the Columbia Pictures Preview Room, 27/F IBP Tower, Jade Drive, Ortigas Center, Pasig City. Directed by André Øvredal, the supernatural horror film stars Lou Llobell, Jacob Scipio, and Oscar-winning actress Melissa Leo.

The film follows a young couple whose van life adventure spirals into terror after witnessing a gruesome highway accident and becoming haunted by a demonic presence known as the Passenger. The film opens in Philippine cinemas on May 27.
